finalists.label: Rhabdomyolysis
finalists.why: It has the strongest evidence with generalized muscle tenderness, restricted movement due to pain, and markedly elevated serum creatine phosphokinase.

finalists.label: Infectious Myositis
finalists.why: It explains the muscle tenderness and elevated creatine phosphokinase with no evidence against it.

frontier_selector.why: The champion is chosen because it accounts for the decisive finding of markedly elevated serum creatine phosphokinase and generalized muscle tenderness, which are more specific to Rhabdomyolysis.

support_spans: generalized muscle tenderness and restricted movement due to pain
serum creatine phosphokinase was markedly elevated at over 90,000 U/L
urinalysis showed no red cells, mild proteinuria, and 6–8 pus cells per high-power field
contradict_spans: serum creatine phosphokinase was markedly elevated at over 90,000 U/L

support_spans: fever and severe myalgia for 4 days
productive cough with yellow sputum but no hemoptysis
sinus tachycardia up to 150–195 bpm and hypotension
